name: After The Reunion
source:
Ten years after graduation, the Class C of Lockwood High are reunited for a night filled with memories, nostalgia, and unforeseen surprise. Among them, the twenty female graduates will find themselves at crosshair of their two playboy male classmates with less-than-honorable intentions, determined to end their night with someone in their arms.

This is a multi-pov VN, each heroines will get their dedicated chapter which will show their subsequent fall to the antagonists after the reunion is over.

[From F95Zone]
